title: Circle gets Abu Dhabi greenlight amid UAE stablecoin and crypto push
summary: Circle has secured a license in Abu Dhabi, enabling it to operate as a licensed Money Services Provider as the UAE accelerates its rollout of crypto regulations.

title: NFT winter deepens: Monthly sales hit lowest point of the year
summary: NFT sales fell to $320 million in November — their lowest this year — with early December off to a weak start as top collections slide across the board.

title: Bitcoin retail inflows to Binance ‘collapse’ to 400 BTC record low in 2025
summary: Bitcoin retail investors have been sending fewer BTC to Binance per day than at any time in history, despite the new highs of the 2025 bull market.

title: Crypto index funds ‘a big deal’ as market complexity grows: Bitwise CIO
summary: Wide crypto-tracking funds will become more popular as investors will seek exposure as the market becomes more complex, says Bitwise’s Matt Hougan.

title: 400K Bitcoin have peeled off exchanges since last year: Santiment
summary: Some of the Bitcoin outflows from exchanges are going to individual users’ storage wallets, but ETFs and institutions are accumulating coins too.

title: Tether deepens AI bet, backs Italian firm’s humanoid robots
summary: The funding will support the development of humanoid robots for industrial use, aiming for “industrial scale performance.”

title: Polymarket trading figures are being double-counted: Paradigm
summary: Paradigm researchers found that major analytics dashboards are double-counting Polymarket’s trading volume due to redundant blockchain events.

title: OCC boss says ‘no justification’ to judge banks and crypto differently
summary: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency’s Jonathan Gould says crypto companies should have a path to supervision in the banking system, which can evolve to embrace blockchain.

title: CFTC pilot opens path for crypto as collateral in derivative markets
summary: The pilot program allows futures commission merchants to accept Bitcoin, Ether and USDC for margin collateral, provided strict reporting criteria are followed.

title: Fitch Ratings flags risk for US banks with high crypto exposure
summary: While crypto offers banks an opportunity to generate new sources of revenue, Fitch warns it could bring risks that could lead to rating revisions.
